population: Top 30 combined official/community shared-leading-paper groups. Preserve ranking and entry membership; a group can contain several distinct products and versions.
objective: Show catalog membership, source download volume with explicit scope, current downloadable formats and recommended publication formats.
size_policy: Prefer exact producer file manifests or Content-Length / object listings. Public metadata only; do not download dataset bodies.
Use a producer-published total where available and state its vintage/scope.
For continuing time series, report a scoped product/period or per-year/per-variable figure and distinguish it from the whole archive.
Separate measured compressed download bytes, publisher-stated size, calculated uncompressed payload and unknown. Never present a raw-array calculation as compressed download size.
No single archive-size claim for an unspecified multi-product paper family. Preserve unknowns and bounded scenarios.
Use decimal MB/GB/TB for computed byte totals; preserve publisher units when conversion is ambiguous.
format_policy: Record native distribution format, not just GEE data type. Do not assume all GeoTIFF files are COGs.
Recommend COG for spatial raster maps; Zarr for multidimensional time series; GeoParquet for vectors/tables and optional PMTiles for vector display. Preserve native grids, values, QA and uncertainty.
If a maintained cloud-native distribution already exists, prefer indexing/referencing it or a justified versioned mirror before conversion.
validation: Exactly 30 ranks, matching frozen work IDs and catalog membership.
Every size claim has scope, units, evidence URL and an evidence/status label; calculations include formula and assumptions.
No citations to derivative search snippets as sole size evidence when producer metadata is accessible.
Review ambiguous product/version groupings and show source vs desired formats separately.
Generate CSV and Markdown deterministically from reviewed JSON; check offline output equality; preserve frozen citation inputs.

delegation.parent: sole committer; synthesis, verification, report generator and final repository state

row_schema.label: friendly product/family name
row_schema.selected_scope: exact product/release/time/variables sized; clarify family not total

download_size.basis: evidence and formulas; no unsupported estimate
